name: Pi-Dash
description: Pi-Dash is a simple, lightweight dashboard for monitoring multiple Pi-hole instances. It provides a clean, at-a-glance, responsive view of your Pi-hole statistics. Before Installing: 1. create the appdata folder 'mkdir /mnt/user/appdata/pi-dash' 2. grab the example configuration json 'curl https://raw.githubusercontent.com/surajverma/pi-dash/refs/heads/main/config-example.json -o /mnt/user/appdata/pi-dash/config.json' 3. adjust the config as needed
